indicator_definition: Perceived level of public sector corruption, scored 0 (highly corrupt) to 100 (very clean). Based on expert assessments and business surveys. Compiled by Transparency International and used in Eurostat SDG monitoring.
rationale: Corruption undermines public institutions and sustainable development. Progress means an improving (increasing) corruption perceptions score.
methodology_characteristics: Compiled annually by Transparency International from multiple expert and business surveys. Scores normalised on a 0–100 scale. Published annually.
